lessons.title: Strategy for definition
lessons.vector_text: universal_reasoning. definition. Define the target and constraints; use evidence appropriate to the claim; test failure cases; distinguish verified results from assumptions; calibrate the final claim.
lessons.strategy_summary: Fix the term, scope, context and boundary cases before explaining it.
lessons.failure_or_counterexample_test: Test whether the definition separates close concepts.

lessons.title: Strategy for comparison
lessons.vector_text: universal_reasoning. comparison. Define the target and constraints; use evidence appropriate to the claim; test failure cases; distinguish verified results from assumptions; calibrate the final claim.
lessons.strategy_summary: Normalize the comparison criteria and populations before contrasting items.
lessons.failure_or_counterexample_test: Swap presentation order and check conclusion stability.

lessons.title: Strategy for estimation
lessons.vector_text: universal_reasoning. estimation. Define the target and constraints; use evidence appropriate to the claim; test failure cases; distinguish verified results from assumptions; calibrate the final claim.
lessons.strategy_summary: State assumptions, units and order-of-magnitude model; compute a range before a point estimate.
lessons.failure_or_counterexample_test: Perturb dominant assumptions and report sensitivity.

lessons.title: Strategy for causal analysis
lessons.vector_text: universal_reasoning. causal_analysis. Define the target and constraints; use evidence appropriate to the claim; test failure cases; distinguish verified results from assumptions; calibrate the final claim.
lessons.strategy_summary: Separate association, temporal order, mechanism and interventions; enumerate confounders.
lessons.failure_or_counterexample_test: Search for a confounder or reverse-causality explanation.

lessons.title: Strategy for decision under uncertainty
lessons.vector_text: universal_reasoning. decision_under_uncertainty. Define the target and constraints; use evidence appropriate to the claim; test failure cases; distinguish verified results from assumptions; calibrate the final claim.
lessons.strategy_summary: Separate knowns, distributions, unknowns and utilities; compare robust options across plausible states.
lessons.failure_or_counterexample_test: Stress-test the choice under adverse assumptions.

lessons.title: Strategy for proof
lessons.vector_text: math_proof. proof. Define the target and constraints; use evidence appropriate to the claim; test failure cases; distinguish verified results from assumptions; calibrate the final claim.
lessons.strategy_summary: Write quantifiers and target; derive lemmas; distinguish necessary/sufficient conditions; close every universal step.
lessons.failure_or_counterexample_test: Search for smallest counterexample and verify each implication.

lessons.title: Strategy for counterexample
lessons.vector_text: math_proof. counterexample. Define the target and constraints; use evidence appropriate to the claim; test failure cases; distinguish verified results from assumptions; calibrate the final claim.
lessons.strategy_summary: Negate the claim precisely, identify the weakest constraint, construct the smallest admissible witness, verify all premises.
lessons.failure_or_counterexample_test: Check every premise and compute the contradicted conclusion.

lessons.title: Strategy for finite verification
lessons.vector_text: math_proof. finite_verification. Define the target and constraints; use evidence appropriate to the claim; test failure cases; distinguish verified results from assumptions; calibrate the final claim.
lessons.strategy_summary: Define search domain and exact arithmetic; record coverage and limits; state only the finite result.
lessons.failure_or_counterexample_test: Re-run boundary cases and state untested complement.

lessons.title: Strategy for optimization
lessons.vector_text: math_proof. optimization. Define the target and constraints; use evidence appropriate to the claim; test failure cases; distinguish verified results from assumptions; calibrate the final claim.
lessons.strategy_summary: Define objective, feasible set and constraints; distinguish local/global optimum; prove bound or certificate when possible.
lessons.failure_or_counterexample_test: Compare against lower/upper bound and adversarial feasible points.

lessons.title: Strategy for conjecture
lessons.vector_text: math_proof. conjecture. Define the target and constraints; use evidence appropriate to the claim; test failure cases; distinguish verified results from assumptions; calibrate the final claim.
lessons.strategy_summary: Separate empirical pattern from theorem; seek invariants, obstructions and counterexamples before proof attempts.
